hero.badge: Made by a freelancer, for freelancers
hero.title: Finally understand where your money goes.
hero.subtitle: Freelance income doesn't arrive on a schedule. Most finance tools assume it does. Freelancer OS reads your bank statement and shows you what actually happened, what's coming next, and what to do about it.
hero.alreadyHaveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
hero.tagline: Free · Any bank · Any CSV format

understand.title: Real answers. Not just numbers.
understand.subtitle: Freelancer OS explains your finances in plain language. The questions you actually ask, answered automatically.

cards.title: What happened this month
cards.body: Income vs expenses vs your historical average. Know immediately if this was a strong month or a difficult one.

cards.title: Where your money is going
cards.body: Every transaction categorised automatically. Subscriptions, tools, travel, taxes, visible in one clear view.

cards.title: What is coming next
cards.body: Cashflow forecasts built from your actual patterns. Know if next month looks tight before it arrives.

cards.title: What to do about it
cards.body: Specific recommendations based on your real numbers. Not generic advice. Actions from your own financial data.

recognition.title: Most months don't look like the last one.
recognition.body: One month feels comfortable. The next, a client pays late and everything feels tight. You've got a spreadsheet you update sometimes. You're fairly sure things are okay, but fairly sure isn't the same as knowing.
items: I don't know if this month was actually good, or just felt good.
I have no idea where 400 euros a month quietly disappears to.
I can't tell if my business is growing, or I'm just busier.
The only time I really look at this properly is at tax time.

philosophy.title: Financial clarity shouldn't be a luxury.

items.title: You shouldn't need an accountant to understand your own business.
items.body: Your bank statement already has the answers. We just make them visible.

items.title: Irregular income doesn't mean uninformed decisions.
items.body: Forecasts and insights built for how freelancers actually get paid, not how salaried tools assume everyone gets paid.

items.title: Your data is yours.
items.body: Upload it, learn from it, make better decisions, make improvements, and stop stressing.

privacy.title: Private. Secure. Yours.

items.title: Bank-level encryption

items.title: You're always in control
